# Lovett Counseling & Consulting

> Trauma-informed therapy and consulting for individuals, couples, and organizations.
> Whitney Lovett, MA, LPC, CCTP — Denver, Colorado. Telehealth across Colorado.

## About

Whitney Lovett is a Licensed Professional Counselor (MA, LPC) and Certified Clinical Trauma Professional (CCTP) practicing in Denver, Colorado. Fifteen-plus years of clinical, educational, and community experience. Her approach is collaborative, relational, trauma-informed, and systems-aware — built on the belief that people heal when they feel truly seen, safe, and met where they actually are.

The practice serves:
- Adults navigating trauma, anxiety, burnout, chronic stress, life transitions, grief, and disconnection
- Couples working on communication, emotional reconnection, conflict, and relational patterns
- Schools, organizations, and helping professionals seeking trauma-informed consulting and training

## Services

- [All Services](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/services.html): Overview of individual therapy, couples therapy, and consulting & training.
- [Individual Therapy](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/individual-therapy.html): Trauma-informed therapy for adults. 50-min sessions, $175. Sliding scale available; superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement.
- [Couples Therapy](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/couples-therapy.html): Trauma-informed couples work focused on communication, reconnection, conflict, and underlying relational patterns. 60-min sessions, $200.
- [Consulting & Training](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/consulting.html): Trauma-informed care training, burnout and compassion fatigue, mental health education, organizational wellness, communication and conflict, staff support and debriefs for schools, nonprofits, healthcare teams, and helping professionals. By inquiry.

## Journal (Blog)

- [How to Find a Trauma-Informed Therapist in Denver](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/how-to-find-a-trauma-informed-therapist-in-denver.html): “Trauma-informed” shows up on half the therapist profiles in Denver. Here's what it actually means, and the questions worth asking before you book.
- [Burnout or Just a Hard Season? How to Tell the Difference](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/signs-of-burnout-vs-stress.html): Stress and burnout get used interchangeably, but they're not the same thing - and the difference changes what actually helps.
- [What Trauma-Informed Care Actually Means](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/what-is-trauma-informed-care.html): Trauma-informed care isn't a technique - it's a set of principles that changes how the entire relationship works.
- [5 Communication Patterns That Quietly Erode Relationships](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/communication-patterns-that-hurt-relationships.html): Most relationships don't end over one big rupture. They erode slowly, through patterns that feel small in the moment and compound over years.
- [Is Telehealth Therapy Right for You?](https://lovettcounselingandconsulting.com/is-telehealth-therapy-right-for-you.html): Telehealth is real, effective therapy — how virtual sessions work, who they're a great fit for, and how to set up your space.
